title: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Running
h1: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Running
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for fitness trackers for running, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at fitness trackers for running using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
products.blurb: Key specs: Built-in GPS with real-time pace, 7-day battery (5-6 hours with GPS active), Google Maps and Wallet integration.
strengths: Built-in GPS means no phone required for accurate route and pace tracking
Heart rate accuracy improved noticeably over the Charge 5 in steady-state runs
Daily Readiness Score gives a useful go or rest signal after hard training days
Fitbit's app remains the most polished for visualizing weekly running trends
limitations: GPS running continuously cuts battery life to 5-6 hours from the rated 7 days
Most advanced metrics require a Fitbit Premium subscription
Screen is small for checking pace mid-stride compared to a running watch

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.blurb: Key specs: Body Battery energy monitoring, Connected GPS via phone, Up to 7 days battery life.
strengths: Body Battery gives runners a clear number for how much they have left to train on
No subscription needed to unlock any feature, unlike Fitbit or Whoop
Comfortable, low-profile band that most testers forget they're wearing overnight
Battery consistently lasts a full week of daily runs with connected GPS
limitations: No built-in GPS, so accurate route tracking requires carrying a phone
Touchscreen can misregister taps mid-run when sweaty
Smaller third-party app ecosystem than Fitbit or Garmin's own watch line

products.name: Amazfit Band 7
products.blurb: Key specs: 18-day battery life, 1.47-inch AMOLED display, 120 sports modes.
strengths: 18-day battery means far fewer mid-training-block charging interruptions
AMOLED display is bright and legible in direct outdoor sunlight
120 sports modes cover running, trail running, and treadmill separately
limitations: Connected GPS only, so a phone is required for accurate route mapping
Zepp companion app is less polished than Fitbit's or Garmin Connect
Band material shows wear faster than pricier competitors after months of sweat

products.name: Garmin Forerunner 165 Running Smartwatch
strengths: Built-in GPS for pace and distance
Long battery for a GPS watch

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
